name: FIRE sells burn the same amount again from the pair and sync
summary: Every FIRE sell also burned the sold amount from the FIRE/WETH pair's own balance and synced, so the attacker's repeated small buy-and-sell rounds drained the pair's FIRE reserve and swapped the inflated price out for its WETH, two blocks after trading opened and 6 hours after deployment.
notes: Loss is the pair's WETH; its FIRE is valued at nothing (rule 12).
